findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step represents aluminum-block preheating as an additional reaction operation. The following HeatChill step already captures reaction heating at 80 °C. Preserve placement into the preheated block as an unmapped physical action instead.
The GC/MS completion check preceding solvent removal is omitted. No allowed operation directly represents this check; preserve it in unmapped_actions.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Placement into a preheated aluminum block is not directly represented by an allowed operation. Reaction heating at 80 °C is captured separately.
GC/MS determination of completion precedes THF removal and is not represented by an allowed operation.
